'''Vigrriev''' was a member of the [[Elom/Legends|Elom]] [[Species/Legends|species]] who served<ref name="GalaxyGuide12" /> the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba Desilijic Tiure]]<ref name="Complete Locations">[[Star Wars: Complete Locations (2005)|''Star Wars: Complete Locations'']]</ref> as a thug and enforcer.<ref name="GalaxyGuide12" /> The Elom operated on<ref name="GalaxyGuide12" /> the [[Planet/Legends|planet]]<ref name="Complete Locations" /> [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]],<ref name="GalaxyGuide12" /> where the Hutt's [[Jabba's Palace/Legends|palace]] and [[Desilijic Complex/Legends|townhouse]] were located,<ref name="Complete Locations" /> though he did travel across [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] on the orders of Jabba or his favored lieutenants, [[Bib Fortuna/Legends|Bib Fortuna]], [[Llleag'Mak|Lleag'mak]], and [[Revidjasa]].<ref name="GalaxyGuide12" />

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:Vigrriev.jpg|thumb|right|200px|The picture of Tanus Spijek used to portray Vigrriev]]
Vigrriev was first introduced in ''[[Galaxy Guide 12: Aliens — Enemies and Allies]]'', a [[1995]] supplement book for [[West End Games|West End Games's]] ''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]]''. The section the character was mentioned in was authored by [[Pablo Hidalgo]], and the character was identified as<ref name="GalaxyGuide12" /> a then unnamed Elom that had appeared in the [[1983]] [[original trilogy]] film [[Star Wars: Episode VI Return of the Jedi|''Star Wars:'' Episode VI ''Return of the Jedi'']].<ref name="ROTJ">{{Film|VI}}</ref> 

In [[1998]], the film character was identified as "[[Tanus Spijek/Legends|Tanus Spijek]]" through the [[Star Wars Customizable Card Game|''Star Wars'' Customizable Card Game]] published by [[Decipher]].<ref name="CCG">{{CCG|set=Jabba's Palace Limited|cardname=Tanus Spijek}}</ref> Despite the new identification, the film character was named "Vigrriev" in "[[The Last Page]]," a poll published in the [[Star Wars Insider 48|forty-eighth issue]] of the ''[[Star Wars Insider]]'' magazine.<ref name="Insider48">{{InsiderCite|48|The Last Page}}</ref> Sources after the poll's [[April 4]], [[2000]] publication date<ref name="Fan">{{SWArchive|url=community/news/2000/03/news20000313.html|text=Star Wars Insider #48}}</ref> used the "Tanus Spijek" name.<ref name="Hasbro">{{HasbroCite|set=Star Wars (Hasbro toy line)|packtype='04 Basic Figure|pack=#10: Tanus Spijek (Jabba's Sail Barge)|altlink=https://www.rebelscum.com/sw0410tanusspijek.asp}}</ref> As such, this article assumes the Vigrriev name used for the film character is in error.
